products.name: iTerm Prime

variants.name: Regular Pay
variants.summary: Premiums payable for the full policy term.

variants.name: Limited Pay (till age 60)
variants.summary: Premiums payable until the life assured reaches 60.

eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: No limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.notes: Max entry age 50 for limited pay (Limited 15 pay: 45). Max policy term is the lower of 70/75/80/85 minus entry age depending on option. Min policy term 5 (regular), 15 (10-pay), 20 (15-pay), PPT+5 (till 60); table layout ambiguous. POS channel: entry and maturity max 65, sum assured in multiples of Rs 50,000. Half-yearly factor 0.512 and monthly 0.087 of annual premium. Special Exit Value available if entry age is up to 40 and maturity age 70+, exercisable in a one-year window at age 55.

benefits.death: Lump-sum sum assured to the claimant on death, provided due premiums are paid; policy then ends.
benefits.other: Special Exit Value can return premiums paid if cover is no longer needed (eligibility conditions apply). Optional accidental death rider.

key_features: Lump-sum payout on death for affordable cover through earning years
Regular pay or limited pay (10, 15 or till age 60)
Premium frequency can be changed during the premium term
Special Exit Value option can return premiums if cover is no longer needed
Optional accidental death rider
products.tax_benefits: s.80C (old regime), s.10(10D) and s.115BAC as per prevailing law
products.description: Pure term plan with regular or limited premium payment and an optional exit value, for income protection up to age 85.

products.name: iTerm Return of Premium

eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: Rs 49.99 lakh as stated; POS channel per POS guidelines in multiples of Rs 50,000
eligibility.notes: POS channel: entry 18-55, maturity max 65, term 10-47 years. Limited pay entry age max 50 when paying till 60; pay-till-60 needs maturity age 65+. Minimum 5-year gap between premium term and policy term for limited pay. Premium modes beyond annual not stated in the leaflet.

benefits.death: Sum assured to the nominee if the life assured dies during the term; policy then ends.
benefits.maturity: On survival, a refund of total premiums paid (100% of premiums, including modal loading and underwriting extras).

key_features: Full refund of premiums if no claim arises during the term
Cover available up to age 85
Up to 7% discount on first-year premium
Lower premiums for women
Tax benefits under old regime, subject to conditions
products.tax_benefits: s.80C (old regime), s.10(10D) and s.115BAC as per prevailing law
products.description: Return-of-premium term plan that pays cover on death and refunds all premiums paid on survival, with limited pay options.

products.name: iTerm Comfort

eligibility.notes: Premium paying term equals policy term. Max policy term is 70 minus entry age (52 at entry age 18). Min maturity age 23. Half-yearly factor 0.512 and monthly 0.087 of annual premium. Ages as on last birthday.

benefits.death: Lump-sum sum assured on death if all due premiums are paid; policy then ends.
benefits.other: Optional accidental death and critical illness riders.

key_features: Lump-sum death payout of the sum assured
Cover through earning years up to age 70
Annual, half-yearly or monthly premiums
Optional accidental death and critical illness riders
products.description: Entry-level pure term plan covering the earning years up to age 70, with sum assured between Rs 25 lakh and Rs 1.25 crore.

products.name: iInvest Advantage

eligibility.notes: CIS has unfilled placeholders for ages, term, premium and sum assured. Min top-up premium Rs 5,000; no top-ups in last 5 policy years.

benefits.death: Base death benefit (higher of base fund value or base sum assured, itself the higher of base sum assured and 105% of premiums paid) plus any top-up death benefit.
benefits.maturity: Total fund value (base plus top-up) including returned mortality charges and loyalty additions, if applicable.
benefits.other: Partial withdrawal after 5 full years of premiums (min Rs 5,000, max 20% of fund value in a policy year); maturity settlement over up to 5 years; lapsed policies become reduced paid-up after lock-in with a 3-year revival window.

ulip.loyalty_additions: Included in fund value where applicable
ulip.return_of_mortality_charges: Returned at maturity (in total fund value)

key_features: 5-year lock-in on base premium and on each top-up
Partial withdrawals after 5 years capped at 20% of fund value a year
Switch between Lifestyle and Self-Managed strategies once per policy year, free
Premium redirection and instalment settlement option
30-day free look
products.description: Regular-premium unit-linked plan with lifestyle and self-managed strategies and partial withdrawals after the 5-year lock-in.

products.name: iInvest Ultima

variants.name: Lifestyle Portfolio Strategy
variants.summary: Automated strategy; can be switched to Self-Managed free of charge at any time.

variants.name: Self-Managed Portfolio Strategy
variants.summary: Policyholder switches funds and redirects premiums; can move back to Lifestyle subject to limits.

eligibility.notes: CIS has unfilled placeholders for ages, term, premium and sum assured. Min top-up premium Rs 5,000; no top-ups in last 5 policy years; 5-year lock-in.

benefits.death: Base death benefit (higher of base fund value or base sum assured, itself the higher of base sum assured and 105% of premiums paid) plus top-up death benefit (higher of top-up sum assured or top-up fund value).
benefits.maturity: Total fund value (base plus top-up) including returned mortality and premium allocation charges and loyalty additions, if any.
benefits.other: Partial withdrawal after 5 full years of premiums (min Rs 5,000, max 20% of fund value in a policy year); maturity can be settled in instalments over up to 5 years; premium can be reduced up to 50%; 3-year revival window.

ulip.return_of_mortality_charges: Mortality and premium allocation charges returned at maturity (in fund value)

key_features: 5-year lock-in on base premium and on each top-up
Death benefit tied to the higher of fund value or sum assured (min 105% of premiums)
Partial withdrawals after 5 years up to 20% of fund value a year
Lifestyle and Self-Managed portfolio strategies
30-day free look; settlement option over up to 5 years
products.description: Unit-linked plan with lifestyle or self-managed portfolio strategies, returned charges at maturity and loyalty additions.

products.name: ULIP Plus

eligibility.notes: CIS has unfilled placeholders for ages, term, premium and sum assured. Min top-up premium Rs 5,000; no top-ups in last 5 policy years.

benefits.death: Higher of base fund value or base sum assured (the greater of base sum assured and 105% of premiums paid, excl. top-ups), plus top-up death benefit.
benefits.maturity: Total fund value (base plus top-up) at the end of the term.
benefits.other: Partial withdrawal after 5 full years (min Rs 5,000, max 20% of fund value in a year); surrender value equals fund value after the 5-year lock-in; instalment settlement over up to 5 years; 30-day free look.

ulip.return_of_mortality_charges: Returned at maturity (in total fund value)

key_features: Five portfolio strategies: self-managed, lifestyle, target asset allocation, automatic transfer and stabilised gains
Partial, systematic, retirement-income and chosen-rate withdrawal options
5-year lock-in on base and top-up premiums
Instalment settlement option at maturity
products.description: Unit-linked plan offering five portfolio strategies and several withdrawal options after the 5-year lock-in.
